fieldUpdates.description: Initial submission action — fires when the user clicks Submit for Approval (or InventoryCheckService submits programmatically) on the Inventory Approval process.
fieldUpdates.name: Inventory: Set Pending Check

fieldUpdates.description: Final approval action — fires when the warehouse user clicks Approve on the order's pending approval banner.
fieldUpdates.name: Inventory: Set In Stock

fieldUpdates.description: Final rejection action — fires when the warehouse user clicks Reject on the order's pending approval banner.
fieldUpdates.name: Inventory: Set Out of Stock

fieldUpdates.description: Activates the Order (Status = Activated) as part of final approval, so warehouse confirmation immediately makes the Order live and downstream Asset / Invoice flows can proceed.
fieldUpdates.name: Order: Activate on Approval
